integrity: Executable finite verification included; complete new character compared with known 384-element restriction. No independent mathematical audit or definitive publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite rational homology representation for the standard 5-regular Clebsch graph only; no integral lattice, equivariant homotopy equivalence, or integral quotient calculation. The previously known wedge of 31 spheres and its full 384-element Q4 closed-Cech subgroup character are explicitly excluded from novelty.
title: Full Clebsch-neighborhood homology character and multiplicity-free symmetry decomposition
